sanskrit_verse: प्रेषणं गन्धमाल्यानां धूपभूषणवाससाम् । प्रलोभनं चान्नपानैर् मध्यमः संग्रहः स्मृतः ॥
transliteration: preṣaṇaṃ gandhamālyānāṃ dhūpabhūṣaṇavāsasām | pralobhanaṃ cānnapānair madhyamaḥ saṃgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The dispatching of fragrances, garlands, incense, ornaments, and garments; and the enticement through food and drink—this is declared as the middle form of gathering or integration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the capacity to invoke alignment through sensory and material resonance
Causation arises through conscious invitation rather than coercion
Capacity-based responsibility lies in the ability to harmonize external elements with inner intent
Restoration occurs when material and sensory offerings realign individual consciousness with cosmic order
Consciousness alignment is facilitated through refined sensory engagement that elevates both giver and receiver
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent offers sensory or material inducements AND such offerings are received without distortion of free will THEN integration has occurred via middle-path gathering
IF a transaction involves preṣaṇa (dispatch) OR pralobhana (enticement) THEN assess alignment capacity of both parties prior to adjudication
IF integration is achieved through voluntary elevation of consciousness via offerings THEN punitive measures are nullified by design
IF sensory-material exchange leads to distortion of svadharma THEN initiate restorative protocol through reflective re-offering
supreme_court_application: In matters involving influence through sensory or material means, the Supreme Court must evaluate not the presence of inducement per se, but the integrity of alignment between offering and recipient consciousness. The threshold of responsibility is determined by whether the act facilitates integration or fragmentation of dharma-svabhāva.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through voluntary reception, not mere presentation. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential unfolding from intent to offering to reception. Proportional responsibility rests on clarity of alignment at each stage. Non-punitive reality holds because fragmentation arises from misalignment, not inherent wrongdoing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate reflective re-offering process where distorted exchanges are repeated with corrected intent
Engage svadharma-reaffirmation protocols for all involved parties post-integration review
Deploy consciousness-resonance calibration tools to realign sensory-material interactions
Establish completion through shared recognition of elevated state achieved via mutual offering
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored through conscious integration, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone serves as the ultimate adjudicator.
